Run name: the name of the report file without extension (p3-ncu-<x>).
Case of the planned request of the run (plan/<run>.json). The value is empty for classes that have no plan record (launches with align unplanned).

Class of the launch. For a launch matched to the plan, the model class of the plan (op, weight type, J, N, for example 'mmq attn_qkv Q8_0 J=96 N=86'); otherwise named from the kernel name and grid only (for example 'mul_mat_vec_q grid=(4096,1,1)').
Number of launches of the class in the run.
Index of the pass of the request that the class comes from, from 0 (P0, P1, ...), from the plan record of the first launch of the class. The value is empty without a plan record.
Tokens N of that pass (plan record). The value is empty without a plan record.
Launches of the class per pass of the traced request (plan record, from the census). The value is empty without a plan record.
Mean measured duration of one launch of the class (ncu).
Mean duration of the same kernel in the nsys trace of the model pass that serves as the proxy of the traced pass.
The limit that sets floor_us (the most frequent one among the launches of the class): DRAM, INT8, FP16, FP32 or launch.

Time at the limit, mean over the launches of the class: the largest of model bytes / 422 GB/s, useful int8 ops / 149.3 TOP/s, fp16 flops / 38 TFLOP/s, fp32 flops / 18.1 TFLOP/s and the launch floor of 1.0 us.
floor_us divided by duration_us.
duration_us minus floor_us: the gap per launch.
duration_us times launches_per_pass: time of the class in one pass. The value is empty without launches_per_pass.
gap_us times launches_per_pass. The value is empty without launches_per_pass.
GPU time of the traced pass in the nsys trace (plan record). The value is empty without a plan record.
ms_per_pass divided by pass_nsys_ms.
Mean DRAM throughput of the launches of the class.
Mean of dram_pct_of_422 of the launches of the class.
Useful int8 operations of the plan (2*M*N*K) divided by duration_us. The value is empty for kernels with no int8 model.
useful_tops divided by 149.3 TOP/s.
Executed int8 operations (sm__ops_path_tensor_src_int8.sum, mean over the launches) divided by the useful operations.
Padded operations divided by useful operations that the tile grid of the plan gives: the value that padded_over_useful should have.
Mean tensor pipe active for IMMA instructions.
Mean L2 sector hit rate.
Mean SM clock.
The three largest stall reasons with their share in percent, for example 'long_scoreboard 22%; lg_throttle 19%; math_pipe_throttle 19%'.
The limit times of the first launch of the class that floor_us is the largest of, for example 'DRAM=60.1; INT8=24.2; launch=1.0' (microseconds).

Where the bytes of the floor come from: 'model bytes' (weights + q8_1 input + f32 output for matmuls, or the read and write bytes of the model, from the plan) or 'measured DRAM bytes (no byte model for this kernel)'.
